limitations: Production installation is a separate receipt.
A full Windows Go run over SSH timed out in the same existing 20-second race test as the baseline; the same-host PostgreSQL native gate passed all 821 tests.
Checkout benchmark excludes network/object download; historical pre-change CI job timings and production install peak were not recorded and cannot be reconstructed as observed data.
Flutter samples measure debug test-renderer CPU work, not physical GPU frame time, jank or connected media.
macOS/iOS native signing and physical voice, PTT, stream and compatible client update acceptance remain separate NOT_RUN gates.
